theme_strategy.landing_page: Dark hero section (rich dark obsidian #0B0F17) transitioning to clean light sections
theme_strategy.app_shell_and_dashboard: Light mode primary (#F8FAFC background, pure white cards) with sharp, crisp dark text and refined indigo/slate/emerald accents
theme_strategy.user_context: Supports switching between Individual candidate/interviewer mode and Organization mode, with Role Switcher (ADMIN, HR, VIEWER) in the top bar / profile menu

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

app_shell.sidebar_width: w-64 desktop, collapsible to w-16 or hidden drawer on mobile
app_shell.header_height: h-16 flex items-center justify-between px-6 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 sticky top-0 z-40
app_shell.global_search: ⌘K Quick Search trigger opening Command Dialog with candidates, interviews, settings, and jump-to links
app_shell.role_switcher_pill: Badge displaying ADMIN / HR / VIEWER with quick interactive dropdown toggle

interviews_20_80_split.left_list_pane: lg:col-span-3 xl:col-span-3 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pr-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-3
interviews_20_80_split.right_detail_pane: lg:col-span-9 xl:col-span-9 overflow-y-auto pl-2 pr-4 space-y-6

dashboard_grid.stats_row: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6

landing_hero_interviewer_panel.description: Original visual mockup showing AI interviewer audio waveform / abstract avatar canvas, current dynamic question prompt, Candidate video stream w/ live ● RECORDING indicator and timeline controls
landing_hero_interviewer_panel.container_style: rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-6 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden relative

score_ring_87.description: Circular SVG radial progress meter showing 87/100, colored Emerald (#10B981) with 'Strong Candidate' status badge and sub-scores (Technical 90, Communication 82, Problem Solving 88, System Design 85)
score_ring_87.badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200

skill_bars.style: Custom progress bar with animated fill width, numeric percentage badge, and expandable AI insight drawer explaining why candidate achieved score

transcript_evaluator.style: Collapsible Q&A blocks with timestamps, verbatim candidate answer quote, and AI feedback callout box with key strengths and missed points highlighted

video_player_modal.style: Video container with simulated interactive scrubber timeline containing AI topic markers (e.g. '02:15 - Architecture Discussion', '08:40 - Algorithm Explanation') and full-screen preview modal

resume_preview_modal.style: Dual-column modal showing PDF document view on left and AI parsed resume tags/skills/experience breakdown on right

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: AnimatePresence with opacity 0 to 1 and translateY(8px) for smooth tab switches
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All action buttons must feature transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0 transition-all duration-150 ease-in-out
motion_and_interactions.waveform_animation: CSS keyframe pulse and scale heights for live audio waveform bars

testing_guidelines.mandatory_data_testid: Every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, dropdowns, navigation links, modals) MUST include a clear kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not use generic Vercel/Linear dark templates everywhere. The app shell is clean light mode with deep slate headers, while the landing hero is dark obsidian.
2. Ensure both Individual and Organization sign-up flows have explicit separate views/routes with an easy context switcher in the shell.
3. Keep role switcher (ADMIN/HR/VIEWER) functional across all views, restricting/disabling sensitive actions (e.g., delete candidate, org settings) when VIEWER role is active.
4. Ensure full responsive design for the 20/80 interview layout: on mobile screens, list view takes full width, clicking a candidate opens detail in sheet/full page view with a back button.
5. Populate realistic data for interviews, transcripts, radar/bar skill charts, and AI reports rather than lorem ipsum.
